_comment: Translation outcome wire shape (D90; murmur_core::translate::result_json; JNI nativeTranslate). Checked by crates/murmur-core/tests/translate_vectors.rs and the Android TranslateVectorsTest. `input` names the Rust value: ok = the translation (+ target, on_device), err = TranslateError::kind() (+ its field); `notice` = TranslateError::notice(), the text the shells show after typing the dictation as said. Synthetic text only.

input.ok: Remind me to buy milk tomorrow morning.

json.text: Remind me to buy milk tomorrow morning.

input.ok: תזכיר לי לקנות חלב מחר בבוקר.

json.text: תזכיר לי לקנות חלב מחר בבוקר.

json.error: Text too long to translate (max 4000 characters)
Pick a target language to translate into
Translation needs AI: turn on AI cleanup (your server, the cloud or a local model)

cases.notice: No AI set up for translation.
